an5.102:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ussaṅkitaparisaṅkito hoti ‘pāpabhikkhū' ti api kuppadhammo pi.
an5.102:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vesiyagocaro vā hoti vidhavāgocaro vā hoti thullakumārīgocaro vā hoti paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.
an5.102:3.1: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ussaṅkitaparisaṅkito hoti ‘pāpabhikkhū' ti api kuppadhammo pī
